claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 4–17.
All 47 games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are available in English.
The championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on March 17, 2026.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed live via FOX Sports (FOX, FS1, FS2).
The 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed live via the FOX Sports App.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed live via Tubi.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed live through Fubo.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic can be streamed live through DirecTV.
FOX Sports / Tubi is the official broadcaster in the US for the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
FOX Sports airs games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic on FOX, FS1, FS2, and the FOX Sports App.
FuboTV offers access to FOX channels with a free trial.
Select highlights are available via the World Baseball Classic YouTube channel.
MLB.TV covers the 2026 World Baseball Classic internationally.
The quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are on March 13–14 on FS1, FS2, FOX.
The semifinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are on March 15–16 on FS1.
The championship of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on March 17 on FOX.
